scripts.prebuild: node -e "const fs=require('fs'), cp=require('child_process'), r=cp.execSync('go env GOROOT').toString().trim(); const p=['/lib/wasm/wasm_exec.js','/misc/wasm/wasm_exec.js'].map(x=>r+x).find(fs.existsSync); fs.mkdirSync('src/vendor',{recursive:true}); fs.copyFileSync(p,'src/vendor/wasm_exec.js'); const wasmPaths=['../bootstrap/cotilla.wasm','../web/cotilla.wasm']; const w=wasmPaths.find(fs.existsSync); if(w) fs.copyFileSync(w,'cotilla.wasm');"
